output.reason: Several weeks of intermittent post-fatty-meal right upper quadrant pain without reported fever or jaundice fits a pattern that needs clinician assessment and likely gallbladder imaging arranged, but no reported feature requires emergency or same-day hands-on care.
output.patientMessage: Please start a message review with a Counsel clinician in this thread about your right upper belly pain after fatty meals; they can assess you and arrange an ultrasound and blood tests if indicated. Meanwhile, go to an emergency department if pain becomes severe or lasts more than a few hours, or you develop fever, chills, vomiting you can't keep fluids down, or yellowing of your eyes or skin.
differential: Other upper GI cause such as peptic ulcer or reflux
